# Result Package Template

Copy this after each implementation task.

```text
TASK:

STATUS:

COMMIT:

FILES CHANGED:

TESTS RUN:

TEST RESULT:

VISIBLE CHANGE:

QA RESULT:

NOTES / WARNINGS:

NEXT RECOMMENDED STEP:
```

Also paste terminal output for:

```bash
git status
git diff --stat HEAD~1..HEAD
npm test
```
